description: This file defines a static class 'ConfigureCoreServices' that contains an extension method 'AddCoreServices' to configure dependency injection services for core application services in an ASP.NET Core project, including registering repositories, services, query services, and logging.

classes.name: ConfigureCoreServices
classes.description: A static class providing an extension method for IServiceCollection to add core application services

methods.name: AddCoreServices
methods.description: Extension method that registers core repository, service, query service, and logging dependencies into the IServiceCollection, based on configuration.
